svg.text: the fold admission gate becomes the requirement that a phase is accepted only when its reduced cosine polynomial jumps to full precision under the deep-vanish floor test and its nested-radical reconstruction reproduces the fiducial coordinate to more than four-thousand bits, the same floor discipline that rejected the artifact degrees 26 and 48 and 68 and 139 and that here distinguishes the genuine fold from a least-dependence pseudo-relation
